description: Search the Dimore d'Epoca collection of historic hotels (castles, villas, palazzi, abbeys, country relais, historic residences) in Italy, France, Spain and other European countries. Returns properties that can be booked online, with id, location, type, rating, pool, pets and page link.

pool.description: Only properties with a swimming pool.

query.description: Free text: town, area, property name or theme (e.g. 'Chianti', 'Lake Garda', 'abbey').

region.description: Region, e.g. Toscana/Tuscany, Umbria, Veneto, Provence.

type.description: Property type: castle, villa, palazzo, relais, abbey/monastery, agriturismo, historic residence.

name: search_properties
